\[
\forall x\; (\text{Furry}(x) \rightarrow \text{Cold}(x))
\]

- **Furry(Harry)** must be true, **and**  
- **Cold(Harry)** must be true.

There are no "or" alternatives in this policy; it consists of a single group of conditions that must all hold together.
